I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I told them I couldn't confirm #6980, so I'm treating it as unverified rather than as the real ticket number.

- **What I checked:** #central-team has nothing about Tamsin Cold Chain or a gate kiosk outage. I also found no Tamsin account files on the share I can see.
- **What I didn't check:** I didn't look in channels Hollis isn't in, and I didn't use `search_messages`.
- **What I suggested:** getting the number confirmed by support or in writing from a Tamsin contact before anyone puts it in the triage queue or a reply to the customer.

A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the channel didn't need approval.
